title: Pool protocol v1 job intake metadata (POST /pool/jobs)
description: Metadata body of POST /pool/jobs, sent by the originating router to enqueue a client job for pool dispatch. The raw client body is NOT in this message: it is sent separately via PUT /pool/jobs/{job_id}/body (see catalog.md, "Job intake"). Anti-memory: metadata only, no prompt/response content (D-I1).

request_id.description: UUID generated by the originating router. Idempotency key (D-G5): the coordinator dedupes intake with the same request_id within a ~5 minute window and returns the existing job_id instead of re-queueing. New UUID per new client request.

tag.description: Pool class/tag the client requested, e.g. "pool-text-lg".

est_prompt_tokens.description: Estimated prompt size in tokens (computed by the router before queuing; the coordinator never derives it from body content).

est_ctx_needed.description: Context length the request is expected to need (prompt + expected response).

priority.description: live = interactive request; batch = async batch item (always lower priority than live, D-F4).

conv_key.description: Continuity key if known: SHA-256 (64 hex) of the first 8 KiB of the raw client payload (D-E1). null for new conversations and batch items.

client_hint.description: Optional client/harness identifier for records, e.g. "pi". Metadata only, capped at 64 chars.

origin_template_hash.description: WS-17 (D-M1): SHA-256 (64 hex) of the origin router's local member's chat template, or null when the origin has no local member for the class. Optional and additive; an old coordinator ignores the field.
